title: node.list result, contract version 1
description: The result of node.list (PRD 5.8, 5.10): a page of the nodes the reader's regions reach, each with its parent, kind, site and path label. The PHP form is Cbox\Cms\Core\Structure\Domain\Dto\NodeList, and the generated codec writes its canonical JSON: keys sorted, no whitespace.

next.description: The id to read the next page after, or null when this page is the last.

label.description: The node's path label: one segment per node from the root of its tree down to it, joined by /, the site's handle for the root of a site's tree, and below it the last segment of the node's route or the node's kind, such as north/news/section.

parent.description: The node's parent, or null for the root of a tree.

site.description: The site whose tree the node is in, or null for a tree that is no site's.

site_handle.description: The handle of the site whose tree the node is in, or null for a tree that is no site's.
